description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 25/01798/FUL: Construction Management Plan (11) in respect of demolition of existing garages and erection of 4x 4 bedroom dwellings with associated landscaping and vehicular access.
decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to satisfy the discharge of condition 11 (Construction Management Plan) of planning permission ref: 25/01798/FUL as no details of no swept path analysis of HGVs or construction plant for the access and egress of site have been provided. The proposal is therefore contrary to Section 12 and 15 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies T4 of the London Plan (2024), CP24 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD47 and DMD49 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014) and GLA: London Sustainable Design and Construction SPG (2014).
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
